## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated, or an explanation is included.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior, prerequisites, or limits changed.
- [ ] This change does not alter frozen V1 semantics (or has an approved protocol proposal).
- [ ] Security, sandbox, privacy, and supply-chain implications were considered.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, tests, and check pass locally.
